Peace

Edward Rowland Sill (1841–1887)

’T 
IS
 not in seeking,
’T is not in endless striving,
Thy quest is found:
Be still and listen;
Be still and drink the quiet
Of all around.
Not for thy crying,
Not for thy loud beseeching,
Will peace draw near:
Rest with palms folded;
Rest with thine eyelids fallen—
Lo! peace is here.
